title: A/P Summary: 61-90 Days, 91 And Over and Total sort largest first
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three vendors, {Vendor-A}, {Vendor-B} and {Vendor-C}, have open bills on today's date with these open amounts per column: {Vendor-A}: Current $100.00, 1-30 Days $200.00, 31-60 Days $300.00, 61-90 Days $250.00, 91 And Over $350.00, Total $1,200.00; {Vendor-B}: Current $300.00, 1-30 Days $100.00, 31-60 Days $200.00, 61-90 Days $350.00, 91 And Over $150.00, Total $1,100.00; {Vendor-C}: Current $200.00, 1-30 Days $300.00, 31-60 Days $100.00, 61-90 Days $150.00, 91 And Over $250.00, Total $1,000.00.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-06 Alder, {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-06 Birch and {Vendor-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-06 Cedar.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "61-90 Days" header.
  2. Click the "61-90 Days" header again.
  3. Click the "61-90 Days" header a third time.
  4. Click the "91 And Over" header.
  5. Click the "91 And Over" header again.
  6. Click the "91 And Over" header a third time.
  7. Click the "Total" header.
  8. Click the "Total" header again.
  9. Click the "Total" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the list sorts by 61-90 Days, largest first: {Vendor-B} $350.00, {Vendor-A} $250.00, {Vendor-C} $150.00.
  • Step 2: reversed, smallest first: {Vendor-C}, {Vendor-A}, {Vendor-B}.
  • Step 3: largest first again, as in step 1.
  • Step 4: the list sorts by 91 And Over, largest first: {Vendor-A} $350.00, {Vendor-C} $250.00, {Vendor-B} $150.00.
  • Step 5: reversed, smallest first: {Vendor-B}, {Vendor-C}, {Vendor-A}.
  • Step 6: largest first again, as in step 4.
  • Step 7: the list sorts by Total, largest first: {Vendor-A} $1,200.00, {Vendor-B} $1,100.00, {Vendor-C} $1,000.00.
  • Step 8: reversed, smallest first: {Vendor-C}, {Vendor-B}, {Vendor-A}.
  • Step 9: largest first again, as in step 7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/R Summary and A/P Summary columns: “A/R Summary and A/P Summary: the name column, Location (when shown), Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
